title: To Study the Effect of Inavolisib in Combination With Fulvestrant in Participants With Breast Cancer (optINAVO)

rules.source_text: Documented ER +/ HER2- tumor according to American Society of Clinical Oncology/College of American Pathologists (ASCO/CAP) guidelines

rules.rule_text: Disease progression after or during CDK4/6 inhibitor and endocrine therapy combination
rules.source_text: Disease progression after or during treatment with a combination of CDK4/6i and endocrine therapy

rules.rule_text: At most 1 prior line of systemic therapy in the locally advanced (recurrent or progressed) or metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Disease progression after or during treatment with a combination of CDK4/6i and endocrine therapy: <= 1 prior lines of systemic therapy in the locally advanced (recurrent or progressed) or metastatic setting

rules.rule_text: Measurable or evaluable disease per RECIST v1.1
rules.source_text: Measurable or evaluable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1)

rules.rule_text: Endocrine-based therapy recommended and cytotoxic chemotherapy not indicated per national or local guidelines
rules.source_text: Participants for whom endocrine-based therapy is recommended and treatment with cytotoxic chemotherapy is not indicated at time of entry into the study, as per national or local treatment guidelines

rules.rule_text: Presence of at least 1 study-eligible PIK3CA mutation
rules.source_text: Confirmation of biomarker eligibility: presence of >= 1 study-eligible PIK3CA mutation

rules.rule_text: Life expectancy of more than 6 months
Ability and willingness to comply with all study procedures including patient-reported outcomes
rules.source_text: Ability, in the investigator's judgment, and willingness to comply with all study -related procedures, including completion of patient-reported outcomes

rules.rule_text: Prior chemotherapy in the recurrent locally advanced/metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with chemotherapy in the recurrent locally advanced/metastatic setting

rules.rule_text: Type 2 diabetes requiring ongoing systemic treatment at study entry
rules.source_text: Type 2 diabetes requiring ongoing systemic treatment at the time of study entry; or any history of Type 1 diabetes
Type 2 diabetes requiring ongoing systemic treatment at the time of study entry; or any history of Type 1 diabetes

rules.rule_text: Prior treatment with PI3K/Akt/mTOR inhibitors in the recurrent locally advanced/metastatic setting
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with PI3K/Akt/mTOR inhibitors in the recurrent locally advanced/metastatic setting

rules.rule_text: Symptomatic active lung disease, including pneumonitis
